metadata.title: ADR-0039 documenting the decision to adopt a fully independent plugin crates architecture.
metadata.author: lucarlig

description:
Adds ADR-0039 documenting the decision to adopt a fully independent plugin crates architecture.

## Changes

- Added ADR-0039 entry to the Architecture Decision Records index
- Documents the decision to use independent crates for each plugin with their own versioning and types
- Plugins can choose in-process (PyO3) or out-of-process (gRPC/HTTP) execution
- Provides clear ownership and strong isolation per plugin

## Related

- Issue: https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/issues/2730

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body: Thanks for documenting this, @lucarlig. The ADR is well-structured and the decision rationale is clear. One minor issue: the document title says "ADR-0030" but the filename and index table entry say "0039". Please update the heading to `# ADR-0039` for consistency.
